title: How do I rotate API keys?
body: How do I rotate our API keys safely? I keep getting error 401 when I try the old key after rotation.

title: How to enable debug logs?
body: How to enable verbose debug logging? Right now the app fails silently and I cannot see anything.

title: How do I configure an HTTP proxy?
body: How do I point the client at a corporate HTTP proxy? Requests crash behind the proxy otherwise.

title: How to run DB migrations?
body: How to run the database migrations from scratch? The migration script throws an exception on a clean DB.

title: How do I increase the request timeout?
body: How do I raise the request timeout for long jobs? They error out at 30 seconds right now.

title: Is it possible to disable the cache?
body: Is it possible to turn the response cache off per request? I see stale errors sometimes and want to test without it.

title: Crash on empty input
body: The app crashes with a null pointer exception when the name field is left empty on submit.

title: 500 on checkout
body: Checkout returns a 500 and the server logs show an unhandled exception in the payment path.

title: Login fails in Safari
body: Authentication fails only in Safari; the same credentials work in Chrome and Firefox.

title: Data loss on refresh
body: A validation error on submit wipes every field the user already entered, which is a real data loss.

title: Memory leak in worker
body: The background worker crashes after a few hours; memory grows without bound until it dies.

title: Wrong invoice total
body: The invoice total fails to round the discounted amount correctly and is off by one cent.

title: Race condition in queue
body: Messages get processed twice under load; the consumer throws an exception and the item is requeued.

title: Add dark mode
body: Please add support for a dark theme that follows the system appearance setting.

title: Add CSV export
body: Add ability to export any report table as a CSV file from the toolbar.

title: Feature request: SSO
body: Feature request for SAML single sign-on so teams can log in with their identity provider.

title: Add webhook retries
body: Add support for retrying webhooks that time out, with a small backoff between attempts.

title: Update README install steps
body: Update the readme; the install section is outdated and still references the old package name.

title: Typo in API docs
body: There is a typo in docs for the auth endpoint: the header name is spelled wrong.

title: Document env vars
body: The documentation is missing a table of environment variables and their defaults.
